mandatory_framing: GT-dependent ceiling and non-GT-identifiable diagnostic subsets are separate. No emitted subset is a trained realizer.

n0_ceiling.n1_composition: Every frozen Wave-3 action compiled individually with its pinned hash. Frozen compile_batch is structurally inapplicable when an action both owns and re-adds an already-correct daughter edge; affected per-video graphs therefore use ordered public compile_action composition with reverse-order hash equality.

n2_realizable_range.caveat: Information-requirement diagnostic only; neither subset is a trained selector or deployment measurement.
